recipe_costs.added: Cluster-local amax/scale; three E5 quantization passes and hi/lo sum VRF work; term assembly and redistribution; three-term DPE input; scale restore before partial store. No latency predicted from bytes.
recipe_costs.removed: Full down E4M3 weight DM materialization and later E4-to-BF16 table lookup. Packed HBM/DM source retained.
recipe_costs.term_assembly: Three explicit Sub copies,480B x16 live slices x2clusters perterm=46080 logical bytes total per read/write; no large weight assembly. This replaces unsafe expanded DMA descriptors.

scope: Complete post-GeGLU E5/native down, including actual quantization/broadcast and F32 block partials/reduction, with original E128 up/gate and final epilogue. Logical payloads are not measured bus traffic or additive latency.

adoption.reason: A positive complete-kernel screen warrants bounded independent contemporary repeats, extra6 and changed-boundary oracle checks; gain below5% is eligible.
remaining_checks: actual post-GeGLU E5 quantizer, distinct cluster scales, block16 F32 partials/reduction, row/cluster boundaries and cancellation oracle

further_tuning.reason: 5% is a provisional additional-tuning budget, not an adoption minimum. No tile sweep is authorized by this report.

major_research.question: Does complete E5/native down shorten the post-GeGLU path after paying spatial quantization, scale preservation, term broadcast, direct FP4 lookup, native block16 partials and F32 scale/reduction? Keep this whole-path result separate from arithmetic feasibility and scheduling-repair questions.

decisions.decision_owner: Root reviewer; these are evidence-based proposed next actions, not an automatic adoption.
